assay_conditions_note: This is the construct for which H-DNA was actually demonstrated in this paper: an H-y3 intramolecular triplex (3'-half of the pyrimidine strand in Hoogsteen pairing, C+.G.C triplets). Specificity controls: 'Two-dimensional gel electrophoresis of pCW2966 topoisomers demonstrated a transition at pH 5.0 that was absent at pH 7.0' and 'No transitions were observed at pH 5.0 in the parent plasmid, pUC19'. KMnO4 marks unpaired thymines, chloroacetaldehyde unpaired A/C (and weakly G); modified positions map to a single-stranded loop (T22) and the triplex-duplex boundary (T49/T50, A47/A48/A52, C51) plus unpaired adenines across positions 23-50 of the purine strand. The 46 bp repeat lies within the 55 bp mirror repeat of P1-sensitive region 4, the strongest P1 site in pCW31. The authors also note they had to add betaine, DMSO and a helper oligonucleotide to let polymerases traverse the repeat, i.e. triplex formed even at neutral pH and high PCR temperature in that context.
